title: A mean correction budget does not acquire the missing likelihood tails
statement: For dP/dQ=exp(R)/C,R>=0,E_P R<=b,a capped correction at thresholdO(b/epsilon) costs exp(O(b/epsilon)). The supplied hidden-label construction changes logZ detectably while proposal samples/adaptive point queries requireOmega(epsilon^-1 exp(b/(8epsilon)))inspections under that information contract. It is not hardness of the explicit Ising matrix or a lower bound on every retained integral. The new common highpass/transfer structure supplies information missing from that oracle. A second-moment shortcut would use nonlocal overshoot2V-V_m outside the equilibrium commutator theorem; a valid static-auxiliary-maximum result still does not determine peak volume/normalizer. Established KLR constant-scale/statistical integration,thermal-average/dynamical Hopfield descriptions and GLL/Gaussian quadrature retain their actual strengths; no priority or generic slow-collective invention claim.
